1st-2nd Century. Possibly 180-185AD. Roman silver denarius. Possibly Faustina Junior. Length 17.6mm, Width 15.9mm, Thickness 2.5mm, Diameter 17.6mm, Weight 2.3g. Obverse: Draped bust right with possible female hair style. Inscription: (VST)[](TVEI). Reverse: Central standing figure, left with lowered left arm. Inscription: Illegible. Die axis: 180 deg. or 6 o'clock. very worn state and originally covered with a thick, irregular brown encrustation probably crreated as a result of water logged ground conditions. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2009, page 50-54
